query: 人才储备与发展战略 人才储备与发展战略 衡量企业关键人才梯队的建设能力、核心岗位继任规划的成熟度。重点考察人才盘点机制、高潜人才储备计划、关键岗位的后备机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的人才盘点机制（如九宫格评估）；针对所有关键岗位制定了明确的继任计划（含“即时/中期/长期”继任者）；建立了关键岗位风险监控与动态调整机制。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的人才库或管培生计划，有定性的继任规划描述，但缺乏系统的岗位风险评估或针对关键岗位的结构化继任名单。 • 0分（不合格）：无人才储备相关披露，或仅笼统提及“重视人才培养”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：继任计划覆盖 >80% 的中高层管理岗位及关键业务/技术岗位。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对集团最高管理层，或未说明具体关键岗位的覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 人才盘点 继任计划 关键岗位 高潜人才 领导力梯队 九宫格 管培生 后备人才 9-box talent review succession planning key positions high-potential talent leadership pipeline 9-box grid management trainee bench strength 9-box 是否建立人才盘点机制（如九宫格）？ 是否有高潜人才储备或管培生计划？ 关键岗位是否有即时/中期/长期继任者安排？ 是否监控关键岗位空缺或继任风险？ 继任计划覆盖多少中高层及关键业务/技术岗位？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '人才储备与发展战略'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否建立人才盘点机制（如九宫格）？ 是否有高潜人才储备或管培生计划？ 关键岗位是否有即时/中期/长期继任者安排？ 是否监控关键岗位空缺或继任风险？ 继任计划覆盖多少中高层及关键业务/技术岗位？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视人才培养”；仅有培训课时统计；仅有校招宣传；仅有灵活办公制度；区分：人才储备与发展战略关注梯队与继任；受训百分比是培训覆盖统计；平等机会是选拔公平机制，三者证据不可互换。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In addition, we have a Business Continuity Plan (BCP) that outlines the procedures that we will follow in an emergency, and the roles and responsibilities of a dedicated BCP team that we call our Subcon Transfer Team. The Subcon Transfer Team will first identify and prioritise critical products based on the impact of disruptions in terms of revenue, expenses, and intangible losses. They will then present the key risks and actions to be taken to the business team. The business team will approve the plan and allocate the required financial resources. Thereafter they will execute the plan, with the business team monitoring the progress and handling communications with customers, suppliers, investors and employees.

In addition, we have a Business Continuity Plan (BCP) that outlines the procedures that we will follow in an emergency, and the roles and responsibilities of a dedicated BCP team that we call our Subcon Transfer Team. The Subcon Transfer Team will first identify and prioritise critical products based on the impact of disruptions in terms of revenue, expenses, and intangible losses. They will then present the key risks and actions to be taken to the business team. The business team will approve the plan and allocate the required financial resources. Thereafter they will execute the plan, with the business team monitoring the progress and handling communications with customers, suppliers, investors and employees.

We conduct regular audits and reviews of our objectives and targets to achieve continual improvement of our OHS management system, and our OHS policies are communicated to all persons working for or on behalf of the company. Quarterly, at our business review meeting, we review the OHS statistics of our manufacturing partner factory. Our Human Resources office in China works closely with the Human Resources team of our manufacturing partner factory to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of work injuries and man days lost. Our customers have also been visiting our manufacturing partner factory and performing their own strict audits of the health and safety conditions for our workers.
